column1: # The PyreOS menu (ADR 0021): what "pyre menu" lists, and the launcher shows
# behind /pyre and in its search. Tab-separated: title, description, verb,
# argument. Data only: a verb is one of the actions "pyre menu" knows, and the
# argument is never run as a command. A title names a row, so each is unique,
# and no field holds a quote or a backslash.
# A verb ending in -list stands for the rows "pyre menu" makes itself, in that
# place: the optional apps and bundles, and the themes.
